topic.title: I've never seen a competition with nearly 6,000 participants before.

messages.content: This has to be the most popular Kaggle competition ever, right?
messages.rawMarkdown: This has to be the most popular Kaggle competition ever, right?

messages.content:
Santander Customer Transaction Prediction competition had 8,751 teams with 9,787 Participants 7 years ago. (27 teams got Gold medals!)

I'm curious whether this competition will surpass that.

https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/santander-customer-transaction-prediction
